mapper.sql: p.payment_id AS id, p.stop_id, (p.paid_at::date - t.start_date + 1) AS day, to_char(p.paid_at, 'HH24:MI') AS paid_at, p.store_name, p.amount, p.method, p.source, p.memo
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (trip_id, stop_id, paid_at, store_name, amount, method, source, memo) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{stopId}, #{paidAt}::timestamp, #{storeName}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{source}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment p JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = p.trip_id WHERE p.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY p.paid_at, p.payment_id
SELECT FROM payment p JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = p.trip_id WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId}
